title: Session liveness and usage accounting
summary: The destructive process-death decision reuses canonical observation chronology under the session lifecycle lock. Later heartbeat, tool or episode activity supersedes even launch-named evidence; repeated reports preserve the original death time. Current deaths retain immediate settlement and holdings, parked-wait and reply protections. Deployed proof remains required. A live QA execution retains its owner across Stop and stale cleanup regardless of inactivity. A verified native exit retains the QA owner while its transcript can resume. A failed native resume lets the session end so another begin can settle its waiting execution.
